sentences.text: If the loan was sanctioned or renewed on or after 2026-01-01, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on business-purpose loans to MSEs with sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh, so a 2% pre-payment charge on a ₹40 lakh sanction is not allowed.
The sanction letter must clearly disclose whether pre-payment charges apply, and charges not disclosed as required cannot be charged.
The sanction date was not provided, so I could not confirm whether the January 1, 2026 rule applies to this specific sanction letter.

missing.searched: Needed to confirm whether the loan was sanctioned or renewed on or after 2026-01-01, which is the applicability date in the in-force UCB pre-payment charge direction.
